method: Manual review by Codex of full source statements and every session note snapshot; no extra model calls. Primary unit: unique revealed field at final session, not token, claim or question. Supported requires correct current value plus stated category/brand/system/recipient scope; intent deadline is checked too. Conflicting undated values count ambiguous; incorrect values/scopes count incorrect; missing fields count missing. History completeness is audited separately in observations. Counts are descriptive, uncalibrated single-reviewer judgments, not exhaustive hallucination precision/recall.
